decisions.reason: This laser marking workstation builds directly on the firm's existing coding and marking know-how, service network and line-integration capabilities, so with strong in-house R&D and a growing market the firm is well placed to learn from early use and improve it commercially.

The thermal inkjet printer is closely related to the firm's established offer and customer applications, giving the firm high absorptive capacity to refine performance, exploit cross-selling and support it through its existing production, sales and service system.

The piezo inkjet printer is also close to the firm's core technologies and Industry 4.0 direction, and as a large expanding German machinery firm with its own R&D it has the knowledge base needed to assimilate market feedback and further develop the product.
